description: This file defines the PropertyService struct with methods to manipulate property fields and values in the Mattermost plugin API, including create, get, update, delete, search, and count operations.

classes.name: PropertyService
classes.description: Struct providing methods to manipulate property fields and values within the Mattermost plugin API.

methods.name: CreatePropertyField
methods.description: Creates a new property field.

methods.name: GetPropertyField
methods.description: Retrieves a property field by groupID and fieldID.

methods.name: GetPropertyFields
methods.description: Retrieves multiple property fields by groupID and list of IDs.

methods.name: UpdatePropertyField
methods.description: Updates an existing property field.

methods.name: DeletePropertyField
methods.description: Deletes a property field (soft delete).

methods.name: SearchPropertyFields
methods.description: Searches for property fields with filtering options.

methods.name: CountPropertyFields
methods.description: Counts property fields for a group.

methods.name: CountPropertyFieldsForTarget
methods.description: Counts property fields for a specific target.

methods.name: CreatePropertyValue
methods.description: Creates a new property value.

methods.name: GetPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves a property value by groupID and valueID.

methods.name: GetPropertyValues
methods.description: Retrieves multiple property values by groupID and list of IDs.

methods.name: UpdatePropertyValue
methods.description: Updates an existing property value.

methods.name: UpsertPropertyValue
methods.description: Creates or updates a property value.

methods.name: DeletePropertyValue
methods.description: Deletes a property value (soft delete).

methods.name: SearchPropertyValues
methods.description: Searches for property values with filtering options.

methods.name: RegisterPropertyGroup
methods.description: Registers a new property group.

methods.name: GetPropertyGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a property group by name.

methods.name: GetPropertyFieldByName
methods.description: Gets a property field by groupID, targetID, and name.

methods.name: UpdatePropertyFields
methods.description: Updates multiple property fields in a single operation.

methods.name: UpdatePropertyValues
methods.description: Updates multiple property values in a single operation.

methods.name: UpsertPropertyValues
methods.description: Creates or updates multiple property values in a single operation.

methods.name: DeletePropertyValuesForTarget
methods.description: Deletes all property values for a specific target.

methods.name: DeletePropertyValuesForField
methods.description: Deletes all property values for a specific field.
